cohort: Women with vaginal deliveries between 2013 and 2018, excluding those with cesarean deliveries, multiple pregnancies, abnormal coagulation profile, and liver or kidney disorders.
finding: Meconium-stained amniotic fluid was associated with a significantly higher incidence of minor and moderate postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: The incidence of postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) was significantly higher in women who had vaginal deliveries with meconium-stained amniotic fluid compared to those with clear amniotic fluid.
